about.title: About
about.text: An interactive map of the Dota 2 world: regions, places and the heroes tied to them. All lore texts are our own retelling.
about.source.official: Official hero biographies and Valve materials — dota2.com
about.source.wikis: Liquipedia and Dota 2 Wiki (Fandom) — for cross-checking and finding places
about.source.media: Comics, trailers and event art — official Valve materials from dota2.com and Steam; each item in the gallery names its source
about.thanksText: To the authors of Dota 2 fan world maps, including “The Map of the Ancient”: their work served as a reference for the world layout.
about.fonts: Fonts: Cormorant SC and Manrope, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the site serves them itself, with no third-party servers.
about.license: The project’s code and texts are under the MIT license. Valve materials (images, videos, names) do not belong to the project and are not covered by MIT.
about.feedback: Feedback — the button in the left rail. Messages are published openly as GitHub issues, so don't include personal data.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.text: A review, a wish or a bug — everything helps. Your message will be published openly on GitHub, so don't include personal data.
feedback.account: You need a GitHub account: “Send” opens a new issue form with your text in a new tab.
feedback.label: Message
feedback.placeholder: What did you notice, what is missing?
feedback.tooLong: The message does not fit into a GitHub link — please shorten it.
feedback.sent: The form opened in a new tab: check the text and create the issue there.
feedback.blockLink: Spotted a mistake or know more? Tell us
feedback.placeholder.error: What is wrong and what is right? A source helps, if you have one.
feedback.placeholder.addition: What should be added? A source helps, if you have one.
